translations.zh: 建中靖國元年，知延安府範純粹奏：「昨帥河東日，聞晉州守臣所得職田，因李君卿為州，諭意屬邑增廣租入，比舊數倍。
translations.literal: In the first year of Jianzhong Jingguo, Fan Chuncui, prefect of Yan'an, memorialized: "When I formerly commanded Hedong, I heard that the office land received by the defending official of Jin Prefecture, because Li Junqing served as prefect, had its rents expanded several times over the old amount by instructing subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianzhong Jingguo 1, Fan Chuncui, prefect of Yan'an, memorialized: "When I formerly commanded Hedong, I learned that the office land allotted to Jin Prefecture's defending official had, under Li Junqing's prefecture, been made to yield several times the old rent after subordinate counties were instructed to expand collections.

translations.zh: 後襄陵縣令周汲力陳共弊，郡守時彥歲減所入十七八，佃戶始脫苛斂之苦。
translations.literal: Later Xiangling county magistrate Zhou Ji forcefully set forth the shared abuses; the prefect Shi Yan each year reduced collections by seven or eight tenths, and tenant households only then escaped the pain of harsh exactions.
translations.idiomatic: Later Xiangling county magistrate Zhou Ji forcefully exposed the abuses; prefect Shi Yan cut collections by seven or eight tenths each year, and tenants at last escaped harsh exactions.

translations.zh: 而晉、絳、陝三州圭腴，素號優厚，多由違法所致。
translations.literal: Yet the gui fields of Jin, Jiang, and Shaan Prefectures, long famed as generous, owed much of that to violations of law.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the gui fields of Jin, Jiang, and Shaan Prefectures, long famed as generous, owed much of that to illegal practices.

translations.zh: 或改易種色，或遣子弟公皂監獲，貪汙猥賤，無所不有。
translations.literal: Some altered crop types, some sent sons, younger brothers, clerks, and runners to supervise harvesting; greed, filth, and baseness existed in every form.
translations.idiomatic: Some altered crop categories, some sent sons, younger brothers, clerks, and runners to supervise harvests—greed, corruption, and baseness of every kind were present.

translations.zh: 乞下河東、陝西監司，悉令改正。」
translations.literal: He begged that the supervisory officials of Hedong and Shaanxi circuits be ordered to correct everything fully."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the supervisory officials of Hedong and Shaanxi circuits be instructed to correct all such abuses."
